evidence.lot_area_band: a lot area of at least 2,000 square metres
evidence.frontage_band: a lot frontage of at least 30 metres

calculation_handling.description: Lot qualification for a place of worship: abutting a major street on the Policy Areas Overlay Map, lot area at least 2,000 m2 and lot frontage at least 30 m.
calculation_handling.gaps: Place of worship is outside the MaxBLD building types; the Policy Areas Overlay Map is not held. Keyed UNUSUAL because the unit mixes a map-location test with two numeric lot thresholds as qualifying conditions for a use, which no single archetype covers.

units.disclosure: A place of worship in the RD zone needs a lot on a major street with at least 2,000 m2 of area and 30 m of frontage; this use is not assessed by this report.

calculation_handling.description: A place of worship must be in a building of no more than 2,000 m2 gross floor area.
calculation_handling.gaps: Place of worship is outside the MaxBLD building types.

units.disclosure: A place of worship in the RD zone is limited to 2,000 m2 of gross floor area; this use is not assessed by this report.

evidence.lawfully_existing: a lawfully existing place of worship

calculation_handling.description: A lawfully existing place of worship is exempt from 10.20.20.100(8)(B) and (C).
calculation_handling.gaps: Place of worship is outside the MaxBLD building types; lawful existing status is a user input.

units.disclosure: A lawfully existing place of worship is exempt from the lot and floor-area conditions; this use is not assessed by this report.

10.20.20.100(12).explanation: A secondary suite on an RD lot must also follow the city-wide secondary suite rules in Section 150.10.

10.20.20.100(13).explanation: A seniors community house on an RD lot must follow Section 150.30. This use is outside what this report assesses.

10.20.20.100(15).explanation: A short-term rental on an RD lot must follow Section 150.13. This use is outside what this report assesses.

10.20.20.100(16).explanation: A laneway suite on an RD lot must also follow the laneway suite rules in Section 150.8.

10.20.20.100(17).explanation: A garden suite on an RD lot must also follow the garden suite rules in Section 150.7.

10.20.20.100(18).explanation: A multi-tenant house on an RD lot must follow Section 150.25. This use is outside what this report assesses.

10.20.20.100(4).explanation: A day nursery on an RD lot must follow Section 150.45. This use is outside what this report assesses.

This use is outside what this report assesses.
